index 0000000..e330e9a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/models/utils_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+//go:build !scanner
+
+package models
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	cvedict "github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary/models"
+)
+
+func TestConvertNvdToModelCvss40(t *testing.T) {
+	contents, _, _ := ConvertNvdToModel("CVE-2024-1234", []cvedict.Nvd{{
+		Cvss3: []cvedict.NvdCvss3{{
+			Source: "combined",
+			Cvss3:  cvedict.Cvss3{BaseScore: 7.1},
+		}},
+		Cvss40: []cvedict.NvdCvss40{
+			{Source: "combined", Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{BaseScore: 8.2, VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/AV:N", BaseSeverity: "HIGH"}},
+			{Source: "v4-only", Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{BaseScore: 5.3, VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/AV:L", BaseSeverity: "MEDIUM"}},
+		},
+	}})
+
+	if len(contents) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("got %d NVD contents, want 2", len(contents))
+	}
+	bySource := make(map[string]CveContent, len(contents))
+	for _, content := range contents {
+		bySource[content.Optional["source"]] = content
+	}
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		source, vector, severity string
+		score, cvss3Score        float64
+	}{
+		{"combined", "CVSS:4.0/AV:N", "HIGH", 8.2, 7.1},
+		{"v4-only", "CVSS:4.0/AV:L", "MEDIUM", 5.3, 0},
+	} {
+		got, ok := bySource[tt.source]
+		if !ok || got.Type != Nvd || got.Cvss40Score != tt.score || got.Cvss40Vector != tt.vector || got.Cvss40Severity != tt.severity || got.Cvss3Score != tt.cvss3Score {
+			t.Errorf("source %q: got %+v, want v4 score %v, vector %q, severity %q, v3 score %v", tt.source, got, tt.score, tt.vector, tt.severity, tt.cvss3Score)
+		}
+	}
+}
